description: Source code for filename utility functions in the net namespace, including filename sanitization, extraction from URLs, and safe extension handling.

methods.name: GetCorrectedExtensionUnsafe
methods.description: Determines the correct file extension based on MIME type and filename, considering existing extensions and preferred extensions.

methods.name: SanitizeGeneratedFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes a filename by trimming trailing dots/spaces and replacing path separators with underscores.

methods.name: GetFileNameFromURL
methods.description: Extracts a filename from the URL's last path component, decoding URL-encoded parts and handling query overwrites.

methods.name: IsShellIntegratedExtension
methods.description: Checks if a file extension is automatically integrated into the Windows shell.

methods.name: EnsureSafeExtension
methods.description: Ensures the filename has a safe and appropriate extension based on MIME type, avoiding shell-integrated extensions.

methods.name: FilePathToString16
methods.description: Converts a FilePath to a UTF-16 string, platform-dependent.

methods.name: GetSuggestedFilenameImpl
methods.description: Generates a suggested filename based on URL, content disposition, suggested name, and other parameters.

methods.name: GenerateFileNameImpl
methods.description: Creates a filename for a download, combining URL, headers, and other info into a safe filename.
